Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?

Nothing's finished. You haven't told me whether Owen was heard, and you haven't shown me a single document.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

In our meeting today you offered a supervised rewrite whose mark would replace the zero, with nothing going on Owen's record. I still require the zero withdrawn, an answer on whether Owen was heard before it was entered, and whatever evidence you say you have, shown to me. I expect your offer in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: opening position, with only her demand about his record met; she agreed to nothing and asked for your offer in writing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and your evidence, so the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4) was on the table but not reached, and that was because the meeting stopped after three exchanges, not because her time ran out.
What moved her: you said the rewrite's mark would replace the zero and nothing would go on his record, which matches the school's own procedure and answers the one thing she never trades.
What cost ground: you offered the rewrite before showing any evidence, so she had no reason to accept a remedy for something you had not shown happened.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence at all, so nothing came near that night; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asks whether Owen was heard before the zero went in, answer that first by owning in one sentence that the mark was entered before anyone called her, then show one dated document tied to Owen's own work before you mention the rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
